dialogues.speaker: Zhenxiang
dialogues.text: Orders have come down from the Qixing. We have to check everyone who comes through here and be on the lookout for suspicious characters.

dialogues.speaker: Zhenxiang
dialogues.text: Don't worry, unless there's an issue my Millelith comrade and I will give you no trouble.

choices.text: Why is your comrade slacking off?

response.speaker: Zhenxiang
response.text: He isn't slacking off. He's just... recharging.

response.speaker: Zhenxiang
response.text: He's in a league of his own in this job — he can do face reading! As in, he can tell instantly if you're someone to worry about, just by looking at you. Most I can do is ask a bunch of questions.

response.speaker: Zhenxiang
response.text: Thanks to him, it's much safer around here now.

response.speaker: Zhenxiang
response.text: I wish I could do what he does...

choices.text: Why are you the only one working?

response.speaker: Zhenxiang
response.text: My comrade knows the art of face reading, and he's right on the money every time.

response.speaker: Zhenxiang
response.text: He did me a while back. Said that as long as I keep working hard, and help out my comrades when needed, I will go from strength to strength in my career.

response.speaker: Zhenxiang
response.text: Covering for him while he takes some time out counts as helping my comrades, right? In which case, I'm definitely on track to do well for myself.
